notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I’m excited to share that development is almost complete! Just a few finishing touches remain — translations, Steam achievements, and adding a bit more atmosphere to the game. 



The exact release date will be announced in our Discord channel, and it will also appear on the Steam page about 3–4 days in advance.
